context:
Goal: Riftbound cards sorted right at stage 4.
Problem (rule): stage 4 runs 4 judges plus a skeptic per set, 25 agents; Sonnet is the ceiling, and Opus needs your named grant.
Based on (ruling): agent-model-cap, Sonnet is the default and the ceiling.

options.gain: Inside the standing rule, and costs less.
options.how: 4 judges plus a skeptic per set, 25 agents, all Sonnet.
options.label: Sonnet
options.lose: A weaker read on hard cards than Opus.

options.gain: The strongest read on each set.
options.how: The same 25 agents on Opus, under your grant for this spawn.
options.label: Opus on a named grant
options.lose: Costs more, and steps over the Sonnet ceiling.

title: Which model runs Riftbound sorting stage 4?
why: Five readers per set already guard against one weak read.
